Runway

Video generation inside an editorial process.

ROfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Connect supported Runway generation endpoints with a reviewed media-production workflow. MoreSpace can build storyboard-to-clip queues, product video prototypes, and creative review interfaces that track inputs, generation tasks, and chosen outputs. A human editor controls story, pacing, sound, and final export so generated clips contribute to a finished campaign instead of becoming unreviewed deliverables.

Useful outputs

  • Candidate clips with task status
  • Versioned reference and prompt records
  • Selected media ready for final editing

Where we can apply it

  • Approved storyboard → generation tasks → editor selection → finished campaign video.
  • Product references → short motion candidates → creative review → landing-page asset.
  • Creative brief → variant queue → selected clips → post-production handoff.
01

Use case 1

Generate candidate clips from approved image and prompt inputs.

02

Use case 2

03

Use case 3

Integrate task tracking and asset export into a creative tool.

Inputs we need

  • Reviewed storyboard and references
  • Endpoint-specific generation parameters
  • Editor acceptance criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Map the creative requirement to a supported endpoint and model.
  • Submit and monitor generation tasks within the agreed budget.
  • Let the editor choose usable clips and complete the final production.

Expert review points

  • Check continuity, factual representation, and rights to references.
  • Verify export quality and attribution in the finished product.
